docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Sivaraja Pillai’s study of the sage Agastya in Tamil literature and tradition (Madras: University of Madras). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Agastya in the Tamil land · Sivaraja Pillai, K. Narayanan, 1875-1941 · [192-?], 112 scanned pages. Published in the 1920s or 1930s (University of Madras); K. N. Sivaraja Pillai died 1941; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
